lines.text: Hi! Do you want to trade your Rattata for\nmy Rattata?
That’s too bad.
Awww! I’m so happy!\nLet’s get started!

Were you surprised?
My Rattata is from the Alola region!\c
Some Pokémon have different appearances and
even types depending on where they were born,
even if they are the same species.
Hi! Do you want to trade your Rattata from\nKanto for my Rattata from Alola again?
Thanks!

I’ve come here to collect a lot of
Kantonian [VAR POKNAME(0004)].\c
If you have [VAR INDEF_ART(0004)][VAR POKNAME(0004)], please trade it
for my [VAR POKNAME(0004)]!
...I see.\nIf you change your mind, let me know.
Are you giving me that Pokémon?\nAll right. Deal!
Thanks for the great trade!\c\nAlolan [VAR POKNAME(0004)] are Ice type,\nunlike [VAR POKNAME(0004)] in Kanto.
Will you trade your Kantonian [VAR POKNAME(0004)]\nfor my [VAR POKNAME(0004)] again?
Thank you! Ah... I absolutely love\nKantonian [VAR POKNAME(0004)].\c\nOf course, I adore Alolan [VAR POKNAME(0004)], too!
Do Kantonian Diglett look smooth?\nMy Diglett looks prickly.\c\nDo you want to trade our Diglett?
You’re playing hardball, aren’t you.
Tee-hee. So exciting.\nLet’s do this.

Wow, it’s true!
It looks so smooth!\c
Thank you so much!
Let’s trade again, OK?
Do you want to trade your smooth-looking\nDiglett for my prickly looking Diglett again?
No matter how many Kantonian Diglett I’ve\nseen, they still look so smooth and adorable!\r\nPlease trade again!
...Are you interested in Dark-type Pokémon?\c\nIf you have [VAR INDEF_ART(0004)][VAR POKNAME(0004)], maybe I could\ntrade my Dark-type [VAR POKNAME(0004)] for it...?
Heh... Suit yourself.
Heh... Have you made up your mind?\nOK. Let’s make a deal.
Dark-type [VAR POKNAME(0004)] are pretty cute,\naren’t they?

You want more Dark-type Pokémon?\c
If you have a Kantonian [VAR POKNAME(0004)],
I wouldn’t mind trading my [VAR POKNAME(0004)]
for it...
...You really like this, don’t you.\nIf you want to shroud yourself in darkness again,\r\ncome see me.

I’m a huge Raichu fan who came all the way
from Alola!\c
Let’s trade your Kantonian Raichu and
my Raichu!
It’s so cute, though!
Have you decided?\nAll righty, then. Let’s trade!
Alolan Raichu is Electric and Psychic type.\c\nIt’s a wonderful Pokémon that can learn Psychic\nfrom a TM.

I’m a huge Raichu fan who came all the way
from Alola!\c
Let’s trade your Kantonian Raichu and
my Alolan Raichu again!
Please spread the word to the world about how\ncute Alolan Raichu is!
You! Do you have a Ground-type Marowak?\c\nIf possible, I’d like to trade my Marowak for it.
No pressure, of course.
Are you mentally prepared for the trade?\nAll right, then.
Whoopee! I love Ground-type Marowak.\nLet’s trade again when we have a chance.
I’d like to trade my Alolan Marowak for your\nGround-type Marowak.\c\nWhat do you say?
I knew it. I just love the Kantonian\nGround-type Marowak.\c\nLet’s trade again when we have a chance.
Hey, you! If you have an Exeggutor, I’ll trade my\nExeggutor for it. I’m very proud of my Exeggutor.\r\nWhat do you think?
You don’t want it?\nI’m very proud of my Exeggutor, though.
Please accept my Exeggutor. I’m so proud of it.
This Exeggutor is amazing, right?\c\nIn the faraway Alola region, they grow up\ncarefree, so they get really tall!

Do you want to get another one of the
Exeggutor that make me so proud?\c
If you give me a short-necked Exeggutor,
I’ll give you another one of mine in return.
There’s such a big difference just because\nthey grow up in different environments.\c\nLife is so mysterious.
Hello there, [VAR GENDBR(00FF,0A03)]sonyoung lady.\nHow would you like to trade your Geodude for\r\nmy Geodude?
Hmmm... Well, that’s too bad.
Hoho! Delightful!\nIn that case, let us begin!

Bahahaha! Surprised, aren’t you?
My Geodude is from Alola!\c
If you bring more Kantonian Geodude, I’ll be
happy to trade with you anytime!
Oh ho! Are you here to trade Geodude again?
Friendship nurtured by trading Geodude...\c\nHow wonderful!\nBahahahaha!
